description: This file defines a React component 'TabbedUserModal' along with internal subcomponents 'UserDetailsView' and 'UserProjectsView'. It manages a modal interface for displaying user details and associated projects, utilizing hooks and external components. It includes UI rendering logic, styling, and interaction handling.

methods.name: UserDetailsView
methods.description: A React functional component that displays user details in a styled grid, including name, email, department, and tenant.

methods.name: UserProjectsView
methods.description: A React functional component that fetches and displays a list of projects associated with a user, with loading and error states.

methods.name: TabbedUserModal
methods.description: Main React component that renders a modal with tabs for user details and projects, managing state and tab switching.
